movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Psycho Shift
movelist.effect: The user is cured of a Status ailment and the target is given that Status ailment. Psycho Shift cannot miss. Psycho Shift can only be used if the user has a Status ailment and the target does not have the status ailment that is being transferred.

movelist.name: Psychic
movelist.effect: The target is Pushed 1 meter in any direction. Psychic lowers the target’s Special Defense 1 Combat Stage on 17+.

movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

movelist.name: Knock Off
movelist.effect: Choose one of the target’s Held Items or Accessory Slot Items. It is knocked to the ground.

abilities.name: Speed Boost
abilities.effect: The Pokémon’s Speed is raised 1 Combat Stage at the end of each of its turns. Speed Boost has no effect while out of combat.

abilities.name: Symbiosis
abilities.effect: The user choses a Held Item they are holding. If the target is willing, they also gain the effects of the chosen item for the rest of the Scene. Items that are activated at a frequency may be activated independently by the user and the the target.
